description: Frames that hold their shape and reshape on a spring when the ratio changes, with photos that fade up out of a blur once they have loaded.
moves: A new ratio is reached on a spring, so the frame reshapes instead of snapping.
The photo fades up out of an 18px blur and a 1.08 zoom once it has loaded; a new photo plays it again.

propDocs.AspectRatio.ratio: Width divided by height, like 16 / 9. Defaults to 1.
propDocs.AspectRatio.speed: How fast the frame and its image move: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
propDocs.AspectRatioImage.alt: What the image shows. Leave it empty for a decorative image, which hides it from screen readers.
propDocs.AspectRatioImage.children: Shown until the image has loaded, and if it fails, like a colour or a caption.
propDocs.AspectRatioImage.onLoadingStatusChange: Runs when the image starts loading, loads or fails.
